About PMUY
Pradhan Mantri PMUY Yojana
Swachh Indhan Behtar Jeevan
In May 2016, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG), introduced the ‘Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana’ (PMUY) as a flagship scheme
with an objective to make clean cooking fuel such as LPG available to the rural and deprived households which were otherwise using
traditional cooking fuels such as firewood, coal, cow-dung cakes etc. Usage of traditional cooking fuels had detrimental impacts on the health
of rural women as well as on the environment.
The scheme was launched on 1st May 2016 in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri. Narendra Modi.
The target under the scheme was to release 8 Crore LPG
Connections to the deprived households by March 2020.On 7th
September 2019, Hon’ble Prime Minister of India handed over
the 8th Crore LPG connection in Aurangabad, Maharashtra.
Ujjwala 2.0: Additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG Connections
under PMUY scheme with special facility to migrant
households. Target number of connections under Ujjwala 2.0
was achieved during Dec’22, thus taking overall connections
under the scheme to 9.6 Crore.
Additional allocation of 75 lakh LPG Connections under Ujjwala
2.0 for three Financial years (FY 2023-24 to 2025-26), which
was achieved during July 2024, thus taking overall connections
under the scheme to 10.35 crore
Government of India has approved the release of an additional
25 lakh LPG connections under PMUY Scheme, taking the
overall target under the scheme to 10.6 Crore connections.
These connections are currently being released.
